channel.title: Daily Tech Opinions Digest
channel.description: Daily digest of interesting tech opinions and blog posts.

item.title: Andrej Karpathy: HackerTube
item.description: Fed up with YouTube's enshittified feed, Karpathy had Claude Opus 5.5 build a full YouTube clone in about two hours, seeded with 6,454 videos recommended in Hacker News comments since 2007. His only manual work: an API key, a VPS, and a domain.

item.title: Frank Calegari (via Terry Tao): Mathematics has changed. Let's act like it
item.description: After OpenAI's 700-paper dump, Calegari argues mathematics has already changed and the community should stop mourning and adapt: AI output is real, badly written, and poorly attributed, and the rush to be first is distorting the field.

item.title: SemiAnalysis: The Datacenter Backlash Goes Bipartisan: Next Week's Midterms and the 2028 Buildout
item.description: 2027's buildout is already under construction, but 2028 is up for grabs: 62.2 GW of planned US additions, most not yet started, with a prolonged Texas permit freeze now the biggest single risk to the buildout.
